method.readiness: settled capacity result, document.fonts.ready, two animation frames
method.inputCapture: Read-only interception of measurement JSON.stringify in the diagnostic browser; retained original measurement objects, not serialized cache-key arrays. No application file edits.
method.replay: Temporary esbuild bundle of unchanged Projection; constructor instrumentation only copied spline knots to a diagnostic global. Original 126/131 coordinates reproduce to sub-micro-pixel precision.
method.server: Initial 1366/1440 records on existing local dev server; 1366 corroboration and 1394/1395 boundary records on own 43138 dev server with WFLYER_TRANSITION_TEST_MODE=1. Not acceptance matrix or final captures.
method.curvatureSampling: Local spline coordinates at 0.001-segment spacing; numerical extrema estimates, not interval proofs. All original 1025 staff points checked independently.
method.thresholdScope: Fixed-height 768px bounded Home-to-About constructor boundary, not global capacity threshold.

telemetry.authority: assembly-stage1-geometry.spec.ts validates every original DOM staff segment and 2049 replayed center points independently before supplemental telemetry assertions; projects-capacity.ts also independently rejects this candidate.
telemetry.mechanism: Every-fourth-point thinning loses 1366 loop even with skip=2; skip=4 independently loses the 1394 two-apart crossing even without thinning.
telemetry.notClaimed: Telemetry is not accurate, and older/unit telemetry-only checks are not equivalent to the complete Stage-1 global gate.

proposedInvariant.localCurve: positive guide x derivative and 1 + d*kappa > epsilon for all visible normal offsets, including both join neighborhoods; sufficient conservative radius bound abs(kappa)*(2*staffSpace+halfStroke)<1
proposedInvariant.renderedContract: All original offset samples advance in x in the local transition; keep global full visible-segment and center-path validators unchanged.
proposedInvariant.seedDesign: Retain valid old controls. For unsafe measured connector, h=max(0.28*W,sqrt(2*R*abs(deltaY)/3)); control1.x=start.x+h, control2.x=end.x-h; R=2*staffSpace+halfStroke. This is a candidate seed, not a universal proof: inspect the final B-spline and its joins, not just the provisional cubic.
proposedInvariant.preserve: Origin points, end/safeY, target, downstream shelves, knot count, existing second-sample adjustment, generic spline implementation and all Projects contracts.
proposedInvariant.failureBoundary: If final local invariant, full ink/clearance or complete capacity fails, do not force acceptance or widen scope. Projects residual already demonstrated; a Home-only correction is not proof of 1366 horizontal qualification.
